text:
lia: dropped a compact mock — toolbar sits inline with message, Stop + Regenerate as micro-buttons; token meter pinned to bottom-right of message. PNG attached. quick takes?

kevin: compact looks tidy on narrow screens. concern: users might hit Regenerate accidentally. consider spacing or small confirm?

maria: prefer no confirm. instead make Regenerate a secondary action (lighter weight) and keep Stop primary. also show a subtle flash when regen is triggered so it's obvious.

jon: token counter: don't update every chunk. suggest smoothing update animation (120ms) and only push UI changes every 200ms. show "sent / limit" so users see headroom.

tasha: agree on 200ms throttle; we'll batch events server-side to avoid event storm on hosted. also recommend a telemetry guard for very long streams (>30s) to sample token events.

anya: accessibility: icon-only buttons need aria-labels. use aria-label="Stop generation (Esc)" and aria-label="Regenerate reply". streaming container should use aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false".

lia: keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+R for regenerate (with prompt library override?). docs team to confirm common conflicts.

kevin: prompt library behavior: drawer should push content on desktop so token meter stays visible; overlay on mobile. ensure pushing preserves scroll anchor when streaming.

maria: copy tweak: rename visible tooltip text to "Generate again" to reduce ambiguity in multi-system threads but keep button label "Regenerate" for taxonomy.

ops-bot: note: canary deploy of streaming-ui for staging tomorrow 10:00 PDT. feature flag "compact-toolbar" available.

lia: plan: implement compact variant behind experiment flag, use tokenUpdateThrottleMs=200, aria-labels, and secondary styling for Regenerate. i'll file the AB ticket and include a11y checklist. :white_check_mark:
